plainTranslation: Tenderness and care fold together. The Moon person feels nurtured by the Venus person's affection; the Venus person feels emotionally safe. Warm, comforting, genuinely sweet. Failure mode: so cozy it avoids all friction and stays surface-soft. Enjoy the warmth; make room for honesty too.
humanMoment: {{holder2}}'s affection makes {{holder1}} feel sheltered, and {{holder1}}'s warmth makes {{holder2}} feel safe. That ease is a gift, but it can also become a place to hide from harder conversations.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their affection lands on your need for closeness, and tenderness comes easily. A gentle, fond, nurturing warmth. Let the softness matter as much as the spark.
tension: The harder part is that comfort can sometimes become the goal instead of closeness. You may avoid difficult conversations, smooth things over too quickly, or tell yourselves that everything is fine because neither of you wants to disrupt the good feeling. But relationships need more than sweetness to grow. They need room for honesty too.
advice: Enjoy how easy this feels. Let yourself take in the affection. Just remember that real intimacy is not only about keeping things pleasant. It is also about trusting the connection enough to tell the truth when something matters.
summaryShort: Their affection lands on your need for closeness, and tenderness comes easily.
